description: This file defines the CallsViewList class, a specialized view handler for listing calls within the SuiteCRM application. It manages search processing and display setup for the list view of call records.

classes.name: CallsViewList
classes.description: A view class responsible for processing and displaying the list of call records, including search and filtering logic.

methods.name: listViewProcess
methods.description: Handles the processing of the list view, including search form processing, setting up display columns, and rendering the list view HTML.
